_comment: Example Cinch assessment state. 'status' is one of pass | fail | na per control id; 'evidence' is a free-text note per control. Feed it to `cinch assess --state examples/assessment-state.json`, or load it in the console with Load assessment. This is the same worked example the dashboard opens with.

evidence.AC-006: Retrieval output is concatenated into the system turn in orchestrator.py:214 — no channel separation. Ticket AGT-3391.
evidence.AC-019: Egress now routes through the allowlisted gateway; verified with a denied direct-connect test on 2026-07-14.
evidence.AC-008: Session memory accepts retrieved content without source labels; retention unbounded. Ticket AGT-3402.
evidence.AC-021: Two agent classes share one service account in staging; prod split is planned for the next infra sprint.
evidence.AC-023: No teardown drill has been run since the June rebuild — procedure exists but is unverified.
evidence.HE-005: Agent reads OPENAI_API_KEY straight from the pod env; broker migration is ticket PLT-812.
evidence.HE-020: No circuit breaker across sessions — a failing tool is retried indefinitely by the orchestrator.
evidence.SC-001: No SBOM is generated for the agent image; syft step drafted but not merged.
evidence.SC-003: requirements.txt pins versions but carries no hashes, so a tampered wheel resolves silently.
evidence.SH-004: Host has no seccomp profile attached to the agent container.
